note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a SER 14, 15; A06b SER 14, 15; L05 No provision): ordinary naturalisation after 3 years' residence; the applicant must give up other citizenships (with major exceptions); a citizen keeps it on taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Serbia, 2024
sources.said: Person has been uninterruptedly resident in Serbia for at least 3 years. ... Renunciation or automatic loss of citizenship of another country (unless legally impossible or unreasonable) required. Retention of original citizenship is permitted on the basis of a bilateral treaty with Bosnia and Herzegovina (2007-). ... n.a.
